summary: Iteration 37 — tested Management Contracts, Bulk Users, and Advertiser Portal end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter37_contracts_bulk_advertiser.py with 29 pytest cases covering all new endpoints (contracts CRUD + PDF upload/download + auto-renew + validation, bulk users with mixed/valid/invalid/duplicates, advertiser register→login→create→pay(mock)→approve/reject→track impression/click→stats). All 29 tests PASSED on the first real run. Frontend Playwright tests confirm: /advertiser-register form submits and navigates to /login; /app/advertiser AdvertiserPortal loads with ad create modal (showing title/body/image/link/duration/live price EGP 350 for 7 days) opening via ad-create-btn; SuperAdmin → companies tab renders correctly with 📋 العقد (ct-contract-*) button on each compound opening ContractModal with every advertised field (start/end dates, commission %, fixed fee, currency, billing cycle, status, auto-renew toggle, renewal months, notes, PDF upload, save/cancel); advertiser-ads-tab visible via ?tab=advertiser_ads with filter pills + stats cards.

design_issues.screen: SuperAdmin → Advertiser Ads tab — empty state
issues: Filter pills and stats cards render but empty-state message 'لا توجد إعلانات' appears only after approving the single test ad. Consider showing pending ads count prominently.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/advertiser.py: `_require_advertiser` allows super_admin/app_owner but then uses `current_user.id` as advertiser_id on create — a super-admin creating an ad will own it under their user id, which may conflate roles. Consider blocking create for non-advertiser roles.

routes/management_contracts.py `process_auto_renew`: uses `timedelta(days=30 * months)` which is inaccurate for yearly renewals (lands ~5 days short per year). Use relativedelta(months=+N) for calendar-accurate renewal.
routes/management_contracts.py: list endpoint strips pdf_data_url for bandwidth, but get-by-id returns full base64 inline (could be multi-MB in JSON responses).

routes/advertiser.py mock-pay branch: sets payment_status='paid' and immediately flips status to 'pending_approval' regardless of whether Stripe was even attempted — fine for dev, but ensure production .env always has STRIPE_SECRET_KEY set to avoid free ads.

superadmin.py bulk endpoint: doesn't validate email format, allows any string; existing DB check queries users collection but skips checks on advertiser collection (if separate). Currently advertisers are in users collection so OK.
CompaniesTab.js (>700 lines): ContractModal + BulkUsersPanel + AddUserModal + CompanyModal are inline. Extract into separate files for maintainability.
test_credentials: Super Admin: superadmin / SuperAdmin2024!. Advertiser: registered dynamically via /advertiser-register with TEST_adv_* prefix. Mock Stripe active (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY empty) → /pay returns mock=true.
seed_data_creation: Test created: multiple management contracts (all cleaned up via DELETE), 2 bulk users (TEST_u1_*, TEST_u2_*), 1 advertiser account (TEST_adv_*), 2 advertiser ads (1 approved, 1 rejected). TEST_ prefix used throughout for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter37 features (management contracts CRUD+PDF+auto-renew, bulk users with dup detection, advertiser portal+mock Stripe+approval flow) working. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter37_contracts_bulk_advertiser.py. Login payload returns field 'access_token' (not 'token'). Compound creation uses POST /api/super-admin/companies/{company_id}/compounds (not POST /api/super-admin/compounds which is 405).
